# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest stable DopeDB release and the current
`main` branch. Older releases are not maintained separately.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please use [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/json-choi/dopedb/security/advisories/new).
Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability, credential, token, or
private customer data. Include the affected version, impact, reproduction steps,
and the smallest safe proof of concept. Do not include live secrets.

We will acknowledge a report through the private advisory, investigate it, and
coordinate disclosure after a fix is available.
